blocks.source: 【質量・物語】
blocks.translation: [Weight and Story]

blocks.source: 今回からイベントシーンでもボイスが付くようになったため、表現力が向上している。ただし、人物のイラストが表示されて、セリフを読み上げるだけの手抜き風味のシーンも多い。
blocks.translation: Voice acting has been added to event scenes for the first time, improving the expressive power. However, there are also many scenes with a half-hearted feel, where character illustrations are displayed and the dialogue is simply read aloud.

blocks.source: キャラクターでは肝心の主人公とヒロインに、もう１つ特徴がなく物足りない。
blocks.translation: The protagonist and heroine, the most important characters, lack that extra defining feature, which is disappointing.

blocks.source: どちらとも、いかにもな「純粋な少年主人公」と「守られるヒロイン」で、もっと、会話にユーモアを持たせるなど、味付けが欲しかったところ。
blocks.translation: They are both rather stereotypical examples of a “pure young male protagonist” and a “damsel in distress,” and I wanted more flavor, such as humor in their conversations.

blocks.source: 仲間のアルノー、ラクウェルや敵側の人物については、上記２名より魅力が出ている。
blocks.translation: Arnold and Raquel, the party members, as well as the characters on the enemy side, are more appealing than the two mentioned above.

blocks.source: 敵側の人物はさっさと退場してしまう場合も多いが・・・
blocks.translation: Although the characters on the enemy side often leave the story rather quickly...

blocks.source: 今回、フィールドのシステムが廃止されたため、寄り道要素などもなくなり、ほぼ一本道になってしまった。（これについては、テンポ良く進めるという考え方もできるが・・・）
blocks.translation: Since the field system was abolished this time, detours and other side elements have also disappeared, leaving the game almost entirely linear. (This can also be viewed as a way to keep the pace moving, though...)

blocks.source: また、プレイ時間がさほどではない割りに、全体的に展開に乏しく「敵の刺客から逃げて、安全な所に避難しよう！」というだけの内容でシナリオの1/3程を消費している。
blocks.translation: Moreover, despite the playtime not being particularly long, the story generally lacks development, spending about one-third of its length on nothing more than “Let’s escape from the enemy assassins and take refuge somewhere safe!”

blocks.source: （短めといっても、早めのテンポでクリア２５時間程度。個人的には、そこまで短くはないと思う。）
blocks.translation: (Even calling it short, it takes about 25 hours to clear at a brisk pace. Personally, I don’t think that’s particularly short.)

blocks.source: 【システム】
blocks.translation: [System]

blocks.source: 今回、何と言っても進化した点はHEXバトルシステム。７つあるマスをうまく移動しながら、戦いを進める必要がある。前作までの単なるターン制戦闘システムから大きく変化して、なおかつ、それなりの成功を収めている。
blocks.translation: The biggest evolution this time is undoubtedly the HEX battle system. You need to advance the battle while skillfully moving between the seven spaces. It is a major change from the simple turn-based battle system used up through the previous game, and it has achieved a reasonable degree of success.

blocks.source: 【バランス】
blocks.translation: [Balance]

blocks.source: パーティは基本的に４人固定。
blocks.translation: The party is essentially fixed at four members.

blocks.source: ・素早さが高く攻撃とアイテムのサポートに向いたジュード
blocks.translation: ・Jude, who is fast and suited to attacking and supporting the party with items

blocks.source: ・補助回復の他、全体属性攻撃でザコ一掃もできるユウリィ
blocks.translation: ・Yulie, who can provide support and healing, as well as wipe out minor enemies with area-of-effect elemental attacks

blocks.source: ・攻撃魔法、異常魔法が役に立つアルノー（このゲームはボスにも状態異常が効くので強力。）
blocks.translation: ・Arnaud, whose attack and status magic are useful (Status ailments are also effective against bosses in this game, making them powerful.)

blocks.source: ・遅いが攻撃力が高いラクウェル
blocks.translation: ・Raquel, who is slow but has high attack power

blocks.source: と、ＷＡ３以上に個性豊か。
blocks.translation: As a result, the characters are even more distinctive than those in WA3.

blocks.source: 特にラクウェルが極端に強いため、彼女をいかに使うかが戦闘のカギとなる。
blocks.translation: Raquel is especially overwhelmingly powerful, so how you use her becomes the key to battle.

blocks.source: かといって、遅いラクウェルには中々ターンが回ってこないため、彼女１人に頼ろうとすると、敵の攻撃をたくさん受けて苦戦することになりかねない。その辺りのバランスは中々良くできている。
blocks.translation: That said, Raquel is slow and her turns do not come around very often, so if you try to rely on her alone, you may take many enemy attacks and find yourself struggling. The balance in that regard is quite well designed.

blocks.source: ・・・のだが、終盤になるとラクウェルとその他の攻撃力の差が開き過ぎてしまい、ラクウェル１人で戦略も何もなく敵を倒せるようになってしまう。途中までは結構いい感じだったのだが・・・
blocks.translation: ...However, toward the end, the gap in attack power between Raquel and everyone else becomes too wide, allowing her to defeat enemies single-handedly without any strategy at all. It felt pretty good up until the midpoint, though...

blocks.source: 【快適性】
blocks.translation: [Comfort]

blocks.source: こういったマス移動系の凝った戦闘システムの場合、面倒で時間がかかりそうな印象があるが、意外にテンポは良好だ。特に通常攻撃はスピーディで、バランスもやるかやられるかの短期決戦型なのでだらだらとした戦闘になることは少ない。
blocks.translation: With an elaborate battle system based on moving between spaces like this, you might expect it to be tedious and time-consuming, but surprisingly, the pacing is quite good. Normal attacks in particular are speedy, and the balance favors short, decisive battles where you either win or lose, so drawn-out battles are uncommon.

blocks.source: 細かいことだが、町人と会話する時に、イラストの表示のため２秒程時間がかかるのが気になる。
blocks.translation: It is a minor point, but I find it bothersome that talking to townspeople takes about two seconds because of the time needed to display their illustrations.

blocks.source: 【音楽】
blocks.translation: [Music]

blocks.source: 今回は今まで好評だったなるけみちこ氏以外の方も参加しているとのこと。
blocks.translation: I hear that composers other than Michiko Naruke, whose work has been well received up to now, also participated this time.

blocks.source: かといって、全体としても曲の質の低下は感じられなかった。
blocks.translation: That said, I did not feel that the overall quality of the music had declined.

blocks.source: 特に通常戦闘の曲は今までのシリーズとも違う味があって良い。
blocks.translation: The normal battle theme in particular has a different flavor from the previous games in the series, and it is very good.

blocks.source: 【まとめ】
blocks.translation: [Summary]

blocks.source: 前作からの変更点が多く、また、物語の展開の少なさゆえに、不評を多めにかっているようだが、個人的には悪くなかった。
blocks.translation: There are many changes from the previous game, and it seems to have received considerable criticism due to the lack of development in the story, but personally, I did not think it was bad.
